links.comparator_used: GPT-4 default responses to the same 33 otolaryngology questions, with no plain-language customization
links.outcome: Readability of answers (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: FKGL reduced by an average of 4.2 grade levels (95% CI 3.2, 5.1; p<0.001); FRE increased by an average of 17.3 points (95% CI 12.5, 21.7; p<0.001); improvements significant in three of four theme subgroups
links.quote: The custom GPT reduced FKGL by an average of 4.2 grade levels (95 % confidence interval [CI]: 3.2, 5.1; p < 0.001) and increased FRE by an average of 17.3 points (95 % CI: 12.5, 21.7; p < 0.001).
